title: Shared components under the hood
items: Cards, buttons, code boxes and form fields are drawn by shared components instead of repeated style classes; pages look and work as before
Light and dark mode run on next-themes, keeping the choice this browser already made
Two-factor and agent codes accept a pasted code with spaces and the browser's one-time code autofill
A long Headers or Query tab can be reached and scrolled from the keyboard in every browser, Safari included
